title: 4BR Retreat for 12 w Balcony, Mins to Broadway!
description:
✔️ Minutes to Broadway, Downtown, and Germantown
✔️ Third-floor balcony with outdoor seating and city views
✔️ 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms — sleeps up to 12
✔️ Bonus loft with wet bar and flexible sleeping space
✔️ Full kitchen with island seating
✔️ Garage parking and private laundry

The space
• Modern three-story townhouse designed for families and group getaways
• Open-concept living room with smart TV and full kitchen for gathering
• Third-floor bonus loft with wet bar, mini fridge, balcony access, and extra sleeping
• Spacious layout with four private bedrooms and flexible common space
• Perfect for large families, friend groups, and Nashville adventures

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept living room with comfortable seating and smart TV
• Third-floor balcony with outdoor seating and city views
• Bonus loft with wet bar, mini fridge, and lounge space
• Dedicated workspace with high-speed WiFi

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12)
• This home includes 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 (1st Floor) — Queen bed; Jack-and-Jill bathroom shared with Bedroom 2
• Bedroom 2 (1st Floor) — Queen bed; Jack-and-Jill bathroom shared with Bedroom 1
• Bedroom 3 (Primary, 2nd Floor) — King bed; walk-in closet; ensuite bath with dual vanity and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 4 (3rd Floor) — Two queen beds; walk-in closet
• Bonus Loft (3rd Floor) — Two queen beds, full-size futon, wet bar with mini fridge, and balcony access
• Baths — Jack-and-Jill bath with tub/shower combo between Bedrooms 1 and 2; primary ensuite with dual vanity and walk-in shower; additional full bath with tub/shower combo; hall half bath

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Island seating for casual dining
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Dedicated workspace
• Smart TV in the living room
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• Minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
• Close to Germantown restaurants, breweries, and coffee shops
• Easy access to Nissan Stadium and Bridgestone Arena
• Near Nashville's top dining, shopping, and entertainment

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Stairs: This is a three-story home; stairs are required.
• Parking: Up to 2 vehicles—1 in the garage and 1 in the driveway directly in front of the garage. Please do not block the shared driveway entrance or neighboring unit. Additional street parking may be available first-come, first-served.
• Security: One exterior camera is located over the front door and monitors the entrance, driveway, and street.
• Pets: This home is not pet friendly. Additional cleaning fees may apply if evidence of a pet is found.
• Sister unit: This home is part of a pair of sister townhomes. You may see guests coming and going next door. Larger groups can inquire about booking the combined/parent listing for both units.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
